sources.title: gemma 3 12b it FP8 — ThinkLLM
sources.snippet: A mid-sized multimodal model that handles both text and image inputs, sitting in a practical middle ground between lightweight and heavyweight options. It runs in FP8 precision, which reduces memory footprint while preserving most of the full-precision capability — a useful trade-off for deployment on constrained hardware. Distributed under Apache 2.0, it's openly available for modification ...

sources.title: APMIC releases the ACE series open-source models 4B and 12B: combining ...
sources.snippet: APMIC has officially released four ACE-gemma-3 models, fine-tuned for the Taiwanese context and combining knowledge distillation and NVFP4 inference technology, providing enterprises with lightweight 4B and 12B model specifications that balance privacy, autonomy, and efficiency.
